afterClose.zh-CN: 对话框完全关闭后的回调；显示期间被卸载，或所在子树被 `Activity` 隐藏时也会调用一次。
afterClose.en-US: Called after the dialog has fully closed. It is also called once when the dialog is unmounted while shown, or when a subtree holding it is hidden by `Activity`.

cancelButtonProps.zh-CN: 取消按钮的属性，类型同 Button。打开后默认聚焦取消按钮，`autoFocus` 为 `false` 时不聚焦；`onClick` 先于内置的取消处理调用，不会替换内置处理。
cancelButtonProps.en-US: Props of the cancel button, the same as Button. It is focused on open unless `autoFocus` is `false`. `onClick` runs before the built-in cancel handling, which still runs.

cancelLoading.zh-CN: 取消按钮是否加载中；不传时跟随 `onCancel` 返回的 Promise，显式传入 `false` 关闭该行为。
cancelLoading.en-US: Whether the cancel button is loading. When omitted it follows the Promise returned by `onCancel`; pass `false` to turn that off.

cancelText.zh-CN: 取消按钮文字，缺省取语言包 `Modal.cancel`。
cancelText.en-US: Cancel button text. Defaults to the locale entry `Modal.cancel`.

centered.en-US: Whether the dialog is vertically centered.

className.zh-CN: 落在 portal 内最外层元素上的类名。
className.en-US: Class name of the outermost element inside the portal.

closable.zh-CN: 是否显示右上角的关闭按钮。
closable.en-US: Whether the close button in the corner is shown.

closeIcon.zh-CN: 关闭按钮的图标；传入 `null` 时回落到默认图标，隐藏关闭按钮请用 `closable={false}`。
closeIcon.en-US: Icon of the close button. `null` falls back to the default icon; to hide the close button, use `closable={false}`.

closeOnEsc.zh-CN: 是否允许按 Esc 取消对话框。

confirmLoading.zh-CN: 确认按钮是否加载中；不传时跟随 `onOk` 返回的 Promise，显式传入 `false` 关闭该行为。
confirmLoading.en-US: Whether the ok button is loading. When omitted it follows the Promise returned by `onOk`; pass `false` to turn that off.

content.zh-CN: 组件版 Modal 不渲染该属性，对话框内容写在 `children` 中；它只用于 `Modal.info` 等命令式方法的选项。
content.en-US: The component does not render it; write the dialog content as `children`. It is used only by the options of the imperative methods such as `Modal.info`.

direction.zh-CN: 文字方向，覆盖 ConfigProvider 的设置；不传时跟随所在位置的 ConfigProvider。
direction.en-US: Text direction, overriding the ConfigProvider. Without it, the ConfigProvider at the position decides.

footer.zh-CN: 完全替换默认页脚按钮。传入 `null` 时隐藏页脚区域。
footer.en-US: Replaces the default footer buttons. `null` hides the footer area.

footerFill.zh-CN: 默认页脚的两个按钮是否撑满排列，默认 `false`。
footerFill.en-US: Whether the two buttons of the default footer fill the row. Defaults to `false`.

fullScreen.zh-CN: 是否全屏显示，开启后 `width`、`height` 不再生效。
fullScreen.en-US: Whether the dialog fills the screen. `width` and `height` are ignored.

getPopupContainer.zh-CN: 指定弹层渲染到的父级 DOM；不传时取 ConfigProvider 的 `getPopupContainer`，都没有时渲染到 `document.body`。自定义容器需要设置 `position: relative`，这会改变浮层的 DOM 位置，不改变视图位置。
getPopupContainer.en-US: Parent element the dialog is rendered into. Without it, the `getPopupContainer` of the ConfigProvider is used, and `document.body` when that is absent too. A custom container needs `position: relative`; it changes where the dialog sits in the DOM, not where it is shown.

hasCancel.zh-CN: 默认页脚是否显示取消按钮。
hasCancel.en-US: Whether the default footer shows the cancel button.

header.zh-CN: 完全替换默认头部（图标、标题与关闭按钮）。传入 `null` 时隐藏头部区域。
header.en-US: Replaces the whole default header: icon, title and close button. `null` hides the header area.

height.zh-CN: 对话框高度，数字按像素处理，字符串为合法 CSS 长度。
height.en-US: Height of the dialog. A number is in pixels; a string is any valid CSS length.

keepDOM.zh-CN: 关闭时是否保留对话框内部节点而不销毁。
keepDOM.en-US: Whether the dialog content stays mounted while closed.

lazyRender.zh-CN: 配合 `keepDOM` 使用；为 `true` 时，首次显示之前不渲染对话框。
lazyRender.en-US: Used with `keepDOM`. When `true`, the dialog is not rendered until it is first shown.

maskClosable.zh-CN: 是否允许点击遮罩取消对话框。
maskClosable.en-US: Whether a click on the mask cancels the dialog.

maskFixed.zh-CN: 遮罩限定在自定义容器内时，是否仍以 fixed 定位覆盖整个视口并按模态处理（aria-modal、页面 inert、Tab 锁定、body 滚动锁定）。
maskFixed.en-US: Whether a mask confined to a custom container still covers the viewport with fixed positioning and is treated as modal (aria-modal, inert page, Tab lock, body scroll lock).

modalContentClass.zh-CN: 对话框内容元素的类名。
modalContentClass.en-US: Class name of the dialog content element.

modalRender.zh-CN: 自定义渲染对话框本身，参数是 `role="dialog"` 元素，返回值必须包含它，例如用 `DragMove` 包裹。
modalRender.en-US: Custom rendering of the dialog itself. The argument is the `role="dialog"` element, which the returned node must contain, for example wrapped in `DragMove`.

motion.en-US: Whether the enter and leave animations run.

okButtonProps.zh-CN: 确认按钮的属性，类型同 Button。`autoFocus` 为 `true` 时打开后聚焦该按钮；`onClick` 先于内置的确认处理调用，不会替换内置处理。
okButtonProps.en-US: Props of the ok button, the same as Button. `autoFocus` focuses it on open. `onClick` runs before the built-in ok handling, which still runs.

okText.zh-CN: 确认按钮文字，缺省取语言包 `Modal.confirm`。
okText.en-US: Ok button text. Defaults to the locale entry `Modal.confirm`.

okType.zh-CN: 确认按钮的类型，同 Button 的 `type`。
okType.en-US: Type of the ok button, the same as the `type` of Button.

onCancel.zh-CN: 取消按钮、关闭按钮、遮罩和 Esc 触发；按 Esc 时参数为原生 `KeyboardEvent`。返回 Promise 时取消按钮保持加载直到落定；对话框不会自行关闭，由使用方把 `visible` 设为 `false`。
onCancel.en-US: Called by the cancel button, the close button, the mask and Esc; the argument is a native `KeyboardEvent` for Esc. A returned Promise keeps the cancel button loading until it settles. The dialog never closes itself; the caller sets `visible` to `false`.

onOk.zh-CN: 点击确认按钮时调用，参数是点击事件；返回 Promise 时确认按钮保持加载直到落定。对话框不会自行关闭，由使用方把 `visible` 设为 `false`。
onOk.en-US: Called when the ok button is clicked, with the click event. A returned Promise keeps the ok button loading until it settles. The dialog never closes itself; the caller sets `visible` to `false`.

preventScroll.zh-CN: 组件内部调用 focus 时是否阻止浏览器滚动到被聚焦元素，不影响使用方自己的 focus 调用；未设置时聚焦会滚动到该元素。
preventScroll.en-US: Whether the focus calls made by the component avoid scrolling the focused element into view. Focus calls made by the caller are not affected. Without it, the focused element is scrolled into view.

ref.zh-CN: 接收 portal 内最外层 `div` 元素的引用，没有渲染内容时为 `null`。
ref.en-US: Reference to the outermost `div` element inside the portal; `null` while nothing is rendered.

role.zh-CN: 对话框元素的 `role`，默认 `dialog`；命令式方法使用 `alertdialog`。
role.en-US: `role` of the dialog element, `dialog` by default. The imperative methods use `alertdialog`.

size.zh-CN: 对话框宽度档位：`small` 为 448px，`medium` 为 684px，`large` 为 920px，`full-width` 为 `100vw - 64px`。
size.en-US: Width preset of the dialog: `small` is 448px, `medium` 684px, `large` 920px, `full-width` `100vw - 64px`.

style.zh-CN: 落在 `.semi-modal` 对话框盒子上的样式。

title.zh-CN: 对话框标题；未传入 `aria-label` 或自定义 `header` 时，标题用于命名对话框。
title.en-US: Title of the dialog. Without `aria-label` or a custom `header`, the title names the dialog.

visible.zh-CN: 对话框是否可见，由使用方控制。
visible.en-US: Whether the dialog is visible, controlled by the caller.

width.zh-CN: 对话框宽度，数字按像素处理，字符串为合法 CSS 长度；不传时由 `size` 决定。
width.en-US: Width of the dialog. A number is in pixels; a string is any valid CSS length. When omitted, `size` decides.
